# EnTT 3.14.0 offline headers

This directory contains an offline, header-only snapshot of
[EnTT](https://github.com/skypjack/entt) version `v3.14.0`.

The `entt/` header tree was mechanically copied from the Adria reference
checkout so Metallic uses the same EnTT snapshot. Upstream build files, tests,
documentation, and other repository content are intentionally not included.

EnTT is distributed under the MIT License. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the
license text obtained from the official `v3.14.0` upstream tag.
